## Work log

<!-- Chronological, written as you go. What was actually done, why, what it cost.
     Reference commits and link to plans and notes. Prose beats a checklist here —
     this is the part you will actually reread in three months. -->

- **Archive shipped.** Yan ran `supabase db push`. The first `vercel deploy --prod` said "Not
  authorized" even though the login and team were fine; the retry went through and is aliased to
  riverbanks-generator.vercel.app. Signed-out smoke test only; the archive itself is still to be
  checked on prod.
- **Thumbnails** ([plan](../plans/2026-10-11_comic-thumbnails.plan.md)). The cause was confirmed:
  each visit to My comics drew every first page live and re-signed every panel image. A new
  token means a new URL, so the browser cache never hit, and every visit downloaded full-size
  (often 4K) images. Now:
  - Each thumbnail is stored at `assets/<comic>/thumb-<key>.webp`. The key is a hash of page 1,
    its bands and its lettering, so no table is needed.
  - The editor prepares a capture once page 1 has changed and settled, and uploads it when you
    leave. Leaving also compacts, which fixes a stale-first-page bug in the list.
  - Cards without a current thumbnail (after MCP edits) are drawn live once and saved.
  - The new migration (`thumb-*` delete policy) is **local only**: Yan to `db push` and deploy.
- What the full e2e suite taught:
  - Capturing at close-out was too slow under load, so captures are now prepared while editing.
  - `html-to-image` embedded all 63 `@font-face` rules; our own embed keeps only Basic Latin.
  - A quick open-and-leave re-uploaded, because close-out didn't wait for the lookup. Fixed.
  - A baseline worktree at `8facaf6` showed `cast`, `styles`, `archive` and `presence` are flaky
    at the default 6 workers without this change too.

### Enter on a focused link or button triggers an editor shortcut instead

<details>

With an image panel selected, Tab to the "← Riverbanks" link and press Enter: the editor enters
image mode (`src/lib/editor/shortcuts.ts:70`) and the link is not followed. So keyboard users
cannot leave the editor while an image panel is selected. Probably `handleShortcut` should let
Enter and Space through when the target is a link or button. `e2e/thumbnails.e2e.ts` presses
Escape first to work around it.

</details>

### e2e suite is flaky at the default 6 workers against local Supabase

<details>

`cast`, `styles`, `archive` and `presence` fail intermittently in full runs, with or without the
thumbnail work. Local Storage is slow (seconds per call), so timeouts trip. Options: `workers: 3`
in `playwright.config.ts` (the full suite then had only the four stale-panel-count failures
listed on [10 Oct](2026-10-10.md)), or longer timeouts on Storage-bound steps.

</details>
